definitions.gloss: polishing; giving a shine; adding gloss
definitions.explanation: The action or product of making a surface shiny and glossy — applied to furniture, cars, shoes, floors, nails, and also to food finishes in cooking. Refers both to the process (polishing) and to the substance used to achieve it (polish).

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{艶出|つやだ}し⟦ワックス→ワックス：28758_wakkusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied polishing wax to the car.
Before baking the bread, brush it with egg yolk to give it a glossy finish.

notes:
Derived from ⟦{艶|つや}→艶：03893_tsuya⟧ ('gloss; luster; sheen') + the ⟦{連用形|れんようけい}→連用形：16646_renyoukei⟧ of ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ ('to bring out'), so literally 'bringing out the shine'. A productive compound-forming pattern: the noun refers both to the act of polishing and to the polishing agent itself.

USAGE:
- As a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-compatible noun: {艶出|つやだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to polish').
- Frequently used attributively: {艶出|つやだ}し⟦ワックス→ワックス：28758_wakkusu⟧ ('polishing wax'), {艶出|つやだ}し⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧ ('polishing cream'), {艶出|つやだ}し⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ ('polishing agent').
- In cooking, refers to glazing food (e.g., brushing egg yolk on bread or pastry, coating soy-sauce sweets) to give it a shine.
- The opposite finish is {艶消|つやけ}し ('matte; anti-glare').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {艶出|つやだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to polish; to give a shine
- {艶出|つやだ}し⟦ワックス→ワックス：28758_wakkusu⟧: polishing wax
- {艶出|つやだ}し⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: polishing cream
- {艶出|つやだ}し⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧: polishing agent
- ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{艶出|つやだ}し: furniture polishing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {艶消|つやけ}し: matte; dulling the shine — the opposite process and finish.
- ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish; to scrub — the verb for rubbing to make something clean or shiny; broader.
- ⟦ワックス→ワックス：28758_wakkusu⟧: wax — a loanword covering the products themselves (floor wax, car wax).
- ⟦{研磨|けんま}→研磨：15434_kenma⟧: abrasive polishing; grinding — industrial or technical polishing by abrasion.
